rules: A claim moves a CERTIFIED input above level 2 only if its evidence check passes (alpha_engine/pipeline/ladder.py). Add claims only with committed evidence. Never infer adoption from keyword matches.

claims.experiment: CBB certified inputs vs incumbent pure-0.2.0 (margin + total residual stacking), frozen 2026-11-20

claims.scope: CBB game MARGIN only, jointly as candidate C2 stacked on the incumbent; TEST 2025+2026, 11,511 games; delta MSE -0.283 [-0.505,-0.085] (~0.1% of RMSE); winner accuracy unchanged; TOTAL got worse (C2 +0.683 [+0.229,+1.138]) so cbb.tempo is NOT claimed. Outcome prediction only; no price-aware evidence. Independently recomputed (research/cbb_certified_inputs/INDEPENDENT_CHECK.md).

FORWARD replication: the same frozen C2 margin model (fit 2016-2022) on 2026-27 games 2026-11-03..15 (517 games, never seen): delta MSE -2.17, date-clustered 95% CI [-3.61,-0.73]. Price-aware on 7,055 Kalshi contracts: every rule loses (C2 R1 -21.5% [-30.9,-11.6]); the market mid beats both models on Brier. PRICE_AWARE is NOT claimed.
